applied_optimizations.name: triton_waves_per_eu_tuning
applied_optimizations.description: Increased waves_per_eu from 1 to 4 in _decode_grouped_att_m_fwd for better GPU occupancy on MI355X. This improved output throughput from 1264 tok/s to 1939 tok/s (53% improvement).

hotspot_targets.reason: Main decode attention kernel for GQA models like Qwen3-VL-8B
hotspot_targets.next_step: Tuned waves_per_eu from 1 to 4 for better occupancy

notes: Baseline: 1264 tok/s output throughput with default triton backend settings
After optimization: 1939 tok/s (53% improvement)
Target was >=1600 tok/s - ACHIEVED
Key change: waves_per_eu=4 in triton decode attention kernel for MI355X
TPOT improved from 12.04ms to 7.47ms (38% reduction)
vLLM reference: 1648 tok/s with TPOT 9.09ms - we now exceed vLLM throughput

applied_optimizations.name: triton_block_size_tuning
applied_optimizations.description: Tuned BLOCK_N from 32 to 128 and BLOCK_H from 16 to 8 in _decode_grouped_att_m_fwd for better memory coalescing and reduced grid size. Also tuned waves_per_eu from 4 to 2 for optimal occupancy on MI355X.

applied_optimizations.name: triton_reduce_kernel_waves_per_eu_tuning
applied_optimizations.description: Tuned waves_per_eu from 4 to 8 in _decode_softmax_reducev_fwd (stage2 reduce kernel) for better GPU occupancy. This improved output throughput from ~1943 tok/s to 1958 tok/s.

hotspot_targets.reason: Main decode attention kernel for GQA models like Qwen3-VL-8B
hotspot_targets.next_step: BLOCK_N=128, BLOCK_H=8, waves_per_eu=2, num_warps=4 tuned for MI355X

next_moves: Explore CUDA graph optimization for VL models
Try different matrix_instr_nonkdim and kpack values
notes: BLOCK_N=128 gives better memory coalescing than default 32
BLOCK_H=8 is optimal for kv_group_num=4 (Qwen3-VL-8B has 32 Q heads, 8 KV heads)
waves_per_eu=2 gives better throughput than 4 or 8 on MI355X for this workload
num_kv_splits=16 (AMD default) is optimal - lower values (4, 8) regress
Quick 32-prompt benchmark: 2053.77 tok/s, Full 128-prompt benchmark: 1955.68 tok/s
waves_per_eu=2 gives better throughput than 4 for stage1 kernel on MI355X
waves_per_eu=8 gives better throughput than 4 for stage2 reduce kernel on MI355X
Lk=128 for Qwen3-VL-8B, so BLOCK=128 optimization is applied correctly (no Lk>=576 override)
Full 128-prompt benchmark: 1958.28 tok/s output throughput (target 2100 tok/s)
TPOT: 7.42ms (excellent decode latency)
